pieces.name: core
doc: //! 🕸️ Meshing: 2D constrained Delaunay triangulation with holes (`PlanarDomain` → `TriMesh2`) as a one-shot call and as
//! the incremental, checkpointed `MeshJob`, plus the region surface schema. The deterministic constrained Bowyer-Watson
//! kernel is first-party; every public type is plain data composed of `f64` and `u32`.

pieces.name: derived
doc: //! 🧬️ Meshes derived from a triangulation or a rectangle: structured quad grids, quadratic promotion, 3D extrusion
//! (wedge/hex) with tet splitting and boundary faces, and the element quality report.
